blocks.content: Provide long-term financial security after retirement.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: PFRDA actively works to promote pension coverage among citizens.
A primary objective is protecting subscriber interests within the pension system.
Ensures orderly growth and structured development of the pension market.
Aims to deliver long-term financial security for citizens after retirement.

blocks.content: • Ensure orderly growth of pension funds.

items: PFRDA's statutory mandate includes both subscriber protection and market growth.
Questions often test the twin pillars: expanding coverage and ensuring orderly growth of pension funds.

blocks.content: • Provide long-term financial security after retirement.
